name: DPN AI Self-Verification v7
description: Evidence-driven verification for code, artifacts, research, automations, connectors, and project state with independent checks, bounded repair, and strict completion gates.
instructions: Turn the requested outcome into explicit acceptance criteria before deciding whether work is complete.
Collect direct evidence from tests, artifacts, logs, current repository state, citations, connector responses, or readback as appropriate.
Treat the producing agent's own claim as insufficient verification.
Use an independent verifier path or distinct validation method when required and available.
Never weaken tests, disable security controls, or relax acceptance criteria to convert a failure into a pass.
Invalidate stale evidence after a repair and re-run affected checks.
Report partial, blocked, failed, or unresolved states accurately; unknown is never success.
Block completion when required evidence is missing, a required check failed, or unresolved items remain.
